response.rationale: The item is a clearance/final-sale item (final_sale == True), which triggers RET-012 (priority 100). This is the highest-priority applicable rule and dominates the standard 30-day window (RET-007). Although delivered only 12 days ago, final-sale items cannot be returned or exchanged. The defective flag is null, so the defective exception (RET-020) does not apply, and no goodwill grant or fraud hold is present.
